s: Dine gezuzetra ubet hakkisse ubo y"z seipim: gezuzetra shehi lemala min hammayim, vechallon patuach lah min habbayit — sheaz hi reshut hayyachid ap al pi sheen lah mechitztzot, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h — asur lemallot mimmenna mayim, lepi shehammayim hem karmelit, ella im ken asa lah mechitztza geboha y' tepachim kol sebibah, vehu memalle beneqeb hechaquq beemtzaitah, sheaz muttar mishshum "gud achet", dehaynu sheanu roim hammechitztzot shessebibah keillu nimsheku lematta ad hattehom, venimtzeu hammayim shettachteha muqqapim mechitztzot, ureshut hayyachid hem. O yaaseh hammechitztza sebib hanneqeb, vehu sheyyehe banneqeb d' al d', shekkol mechitztza haasuya lepachot mechalal d' enah mechitztza. Veen chilluq ben im yaaseh lah mechitztza zo lematta mechubbar lah tachat kol sebibah, o mechubbar tachat sebibot hanneqeb, uben im yaasenna al gabbah milmala beinyan zeh, ubilbad sheyyaasenna bishbil kak — kede lehattir milluy hammayim. Abal im asaah letzorek acher, en omerim bah "gud achet", mittaam sheyyitbaer. Vekevan sheasa lah mechitztza — muttar gam lishpok mimmenna derek hanneqeb shebbah, ap al pi shehashshopakin holekim lachutz lehalea mikkeneged hammechitztza, kevan sheeno mitkavven lekak:

Veken haholek bispina shehi amuqqa asara urechaba d', shehi reshut hayyachid, eno yakol lemallot mehammayim o hannahar shehu karmelit, ella im ken yaaseh dap d' al d' veoseh bo neqeb umemalle derek sham. Veeno tzarik laasot mechitztza sebibo, ella anu omerim "gud achet", dehaynu sheanu roim tzedade haddap keillu nimsheku veyaredu lematta ad hattehom, venimtzeu hammayim shettachtayv muqqapim mechitztza, sheheqellu bispina yoter mibbigzuzetra shebbabbayit, mippene sheeno yakol laasot bispina mah sheyyakol laasot babbayit:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheddopne hassepina enam gebohim y' tepachim meal pene hammayim mibbachutz, ella betokah bilbad hi amuqqa asara. Abal im hem gebohim y' tepachim meal hammayim, shennimtza keshemmemalle derek mala mehaddepanot holek haddeli derek mala measara meal hammayim, shehu avir meqom petur — en tzarik laasot dap d', ella day beziz kol shehu lehekker beolma, shello yabo letaltel mereshut hayyachid lekarmelit shello bederek avir meqom petur. Ulepikak en tzarik laasot neqeb bazziz lemallot derek sham, ella yakol lemallot bekol hassepina al yede hekker ziz sheasa bemaqom echad mehassepina. Vaapillu haoserim letaltel mereshut hayyachid lekarmelit apillu derek hannacha bimqom petur benetayim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v, kan sheyyesh ziz kol shehu lehekker — modim shemmuttar, shehare taam haissur eno ella mishshum shemma yabo letaltel shello bederek meqom petur benetayim, kemo shennitbaer sham, vekan hare yesh lo hekker beziz kol shehu. (Uledibre haomerim shemmuttar letaltel mereshut hayyachid lekarmelit derek hannacha bimqom petur, abal lo derek avir meqom petur, en hekker ziz moil lemala measara, kemo sheeno moil lematta mi' tepachim. Velaken tzarik laasot kan bitchilla hannacha lehaddeli al hazziz, shehu meqom petur, veachar kak yeshalshelennu lammayim, veken behachazarato):

Vekol zeh lemallot mehayyam lispina. Abal lishpok shopakin mehassepina layyam, o lizroq mimmenna atzamot uqelippin — en tzarik lo dap velo ziz, apillu im dopne hassepina enam gebohim y' tepachim meal pene hammayim mibbachutz, ella shopekan o zoreqan al chudde dopne hassepina milmala, sheshsham hu avir reshut hayyachid — kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h shemmechitztzot shel reshut hayyachid al gabbehen reshut hayyachid — umishsham hem yoredim derek dopnoteha layyam. Veap al pi sheen nachim kelal al haddopen ella yoredim miyyad layyam, ulekak hu mitkavven, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno shopekan vezoreqan beyadayv layyam ella laddopen, umikkocho hem baim layyam, vekocho bekarmelit lo gazeru. Abal im (eno) rotzeh lishpok al haddopen mammash, ela merachoq qetzat letok hayyam mammash, tzarik gam ken hekker ziz o dap d' al d' naqub, veyishpok derek hanneqeb al derek shennitbaer bemilluy:

Vekol zeh kesheddopne hassepina hem gebohim y' tepachim, sheaz hi reshut hayyachid. Abal im enan gebohim asara — karmelit hi ap al pi shehi keli, umuttar lemallot lishpok mimmenna layyam bekol inyan belo dap ubelo ziz, shehare muttar letaltel mikkarmelit lekarmelit. Velo ameru sheen karmelit bekelim ella bikli haomed birshut harabbim, shehu batel lirshut harabbim venaaseh kamoha, abal kesheomed bekarmelit, karmelit hu:
Lepikak yesh lizzaher shello letaltel betokah yoter mid' ammot kedin karmelit. Veim yesh bayit bispina, asur lehotzi mehabbayit lispina:

Veken sepinot qetannot shemmitqatztzerot lematta ad kechuddo shel sakkin, vehaqqatzar shellahen gaboah g' tepachim, sheen rochab d' tepachim lematta beod shello higbihu g' tepachim miqqarqaito — en metaltelim betoko yoter mid' ammot, apillu yesh bimchitztzoteha gobah y' tepachim mimmaqom shehirchibu d' ulemala, shekkevan shebbimqom haqqatzar en lah mechitztzot kelal — shekkol mechitztza haasuya lechalal pachot mid' tepachim enah mechitztza, kemo shennitbaer lemala — im ken mimmaqom shehirchibu (hammechitztzot) d' tepachim ulemala hen kimchitztzot hatteluyot baavir, sheen lahem din mechitztza, veen omerim bahen "gud achet" ella im ken naasu lehattir tiltul bemayim, kemo sheyyitbaer. Abal im ad shello higbihu g' hirchibu d', hare hen kemo sheqqarqeitan ola ad kan umechitztzotehen mechitztzot. Veken im mille qanim beqarqaitan ad meqom rochban, hare hen mechitztzot kesherot (lemala) im yesh bahen y' mishsham ulemala:

B' sepinot semukot zo lezo sheen benehem d' tepachim keshiur karmelit, metaltelin mizzo lazo. Veim hem shel b' bene adam, en metaltelin mizzo lezo ella im ken erebu yachad. Veen haerub moil ella im ken hen qeshurot zo bazo, sheim enan qeshurot zo bazo, hare hen yekolot lanud ulehitpared zo mizzo utehe karmelit mapseqet benehem, veen zeh erub reshuyyot. Veim hayu qeshurot venipsequ beshabbat — batel haerub, veen omerim bezeh "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", ayyen simman (shm"t) [shs"b]:

Veim dopne hassepina gebohim y' tepachim meal pene hammayim mibbachutz, muttar letaltel mizzo lezo apillu muplagot zo mizzo harbeh, shehare hu metaltel mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derek mala measara, shehu meqom petur. Vaapillu hen shel shenayim, muttar beli erub lehammattirim letaltel derek avir meqom petur birshuyyot shel dibrehem, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v. Ukebar nitbaer sham shehaiqqar kehaoserim bezeh:

Bet hakkisse sheal pene hammayim, muttar lippanot bo al yede mechitztza teluya sheyyaasenna lematta sebibo, al derek shennitbaer bigzuzetra, shebbimchitztza zo omerim bah "gud achet", hoil vehi asuya bishbil kak — kede lehattir lippanot sham beshabbat. Abal bimchitztzot bet hakkisse atzman, hoil veenan asuyot lehattir ella litzniut, en omerim bahem "gud achet", lepi shemmin haddin lo haya rauy lehattir kelal mishshum "gud achet" apillu bimchitztza teluya lematta, shehare bimchitztzot hatteluyot beyabbasha haggebohot g' tepachim min haaretz en omerim bahem "gud achet", lepi shehaggedayim yekolim libqoa tachtehem, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h — vekan bemayim, ap sheen haggedayim yekolim libqoa sham, mikkol maqom hare dagim yekolim libqoa sham — umippene zeh en haggezuzetra reshut hayyachid ella im ken challon patuach lah. Ella qal hu sheheqellu chakamim bemayim lomar "gud achet", hoil veen beqiat haddagim niret, velo heqellu ella kesheasa hammechitztza leshem hammayim, kede lehattir bahem hattiltul, sheyyesh lo bezeh hekker vezikkaron shehammayim shettachtehem karmelit hem, veen hattiltul muttar sham ella al yede mechitztza. Abal mechitztza shello naaset bishbil kak, en bah hekker kelal:

Veim asa dap o apillu qaneh daq shettippol hatztzoa aleha qodem shettippol lammayim — en tzarik limchitztza kelal im hem bepachot mig' lanneqeb, shekkelabud hem, vahare hem kechore reshut hayyachid shenniddonim kirshut hayyachid, venimtza hu motzi hatztzoa mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid, umikkocho hi nopelet lammayim shehem karmelit, vekocho bekarmelit lo gazeru. Vehu haddin im bet hakkisse asuy kak shehatztzoa nopelet al tzidde hakkotel shebbebet hakkisse shehu reshut hayyachid, veachar kak mitgalgelet venopelet lematta bekarmelit. Vekol zeh bekarmelit shechutz lair, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shn"z. Veim nishbar haqqaneh o haddap beshabbat — muttar lippanot sham, shemmishshum kebod habberiyyot lo gazeru al issur hakkarmelit, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"b:

Im bet hakkisse bolet chutz lechomat hair, vetzoa nopelet bachapira shessabib hair, sheyyesh bachapira zo yoter mibbet satayim vahare hi karmelit, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shn"ch — eno muttar al yede mechitztza teluya millematta, shello hittiruha ella bemayim, mittaam shennitbaer, abal lo beyabbasha. Abal al yede dap o qaneh muttar, shekkocho muttar bekol karmelit sheenah betok hair. Ulepi dibre hammattirim letaltel mereshut hayyachid lekarmelit derek avir meqom petur, en tzarik mechitztza kelal velo dap o qaneh bekol bet hakkisse shehi lemala measara miqqarqa hakkarmelit. Ukebar nitbaer shehaiqqar kehacholeqim alehem. Veyesh omerim sheim hayeta sham tzoa mibbeod yom bekarmelit vehu nipneh akshav aleha — muttar bekol inyan, veap al pi sheachar kak nopelet mealeha leqarqa hakkarmelit, lepi shehatztzoa shemmibbeod yom hi meqom petur (im en bah d' al d') (vehi geboha g', o apillu enah geboha g' ella sherchaba d', sheen rabbim poseim umedallegim aleha ella maqqipin otah). Abal lepi mah shennitbaer besimman shm"h shehaiqqar kehaomerim sheen meqom petur bekarmelit, en lehaqel bezeh. Ulepi mah shennitbaer sham shelledibre hakkol en meqom petur birshut hayyachid, im ken bet hakkisse haomed ben b' battim, im lo erebu yachad — asurim lippanot sham ledibre hakkol, apillu hayeta sham tzoa mibbeod yom, im lo al yede dap veqaneh, sheaz muttar ap al pi shehi betok hair, lepi shebbechatzer sheenah meorebet lo gazeru al kocho, ap al pi shehi betok hair, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"z:
Vekol zeh lekattechilla. Abal bediabad, sheshshakechu velo erebu — muttar mishshum kebod habberiyyot:
Holeke sepinot nahagu laasot tzorkehem min hammeshita leyam, hoil vehammeshita enah geboha asara mehammayim — ap al pi sherchaba d' — enah ella karmelit, umotzi mikkarmelit lekarmelit:

(Lo hittiru bemayim mechitztza teluya ella kesheen derisat haregel oberet sham bahem mechamat omqam, ap al pi sheenam amuqqim asara. Abal) mayim sheharabbim boqeim bahen en mechitztza teluya matteret bahem (apillu im hem amuqqim asara, vaapillu hem bekarmelit), lepi shebbeqiat harabbim meakkebet millomar "gud achet". Veken im yabeshu hammayim, en mechitztza teluya matteret sham meakshav, sheen mechitztza teluya matteret bayyabbasha apillu becharitz amoq, kemo shennitbaer:

Hayu b' gezuzetraot zo lemala mizzo, ben im omedot tok y' tepachim zo lezo ben yesh benehen gobah yoter meeser ammot, veasu laelyona hammechitztza vehanneqeb velo asu lattachtona, ubeshabbat zoreqin bene hattachtona deli shellahem al mechitztzot haelyona, veyored lanneqeb umeshalshel umoshek veoleh, kegon shezzo meshuka mikkeneged zo meat veenah tachteha mammash — hare shettehem asurot lemallot ad sheyyearebu, mippene shershut shettehen sholetet sham. Ukegon sheasu otah mechitztza beshuttaput. Abal im haelyona osta hammechitztza lebaddah — en hattachtona oseret aleha, apillu hi regila lehishtammesh bah gam bechol, kevan shemmishtammeshet bah shello kaddin. Veken im asav lattachtona velo asu laelyona — en haelyona oseret aleha, ella im ken osta imma beshuttaput. Veim asu bishtehen, apillu asu bekol echad beshuttaput (umikkol maqom kol achat mishtammeshet beshellah) (vetzarik iyyun tama degilluy daat), en achat oseret al chabertah, umah sheasauha beshuttaput hu meezeh taam acher:

Vekol zeh keshezzo enah meshuka mikkeneged zo ella meat, dehaynu pachot mid' tepachim. Abal im meshuka mikkenegdah d' tepachim, ben sheasu laelyona velo lattachtona ben sheasu lattachtona velo laelyona — muttarot shenehem lemallot beli erub, veen otah sheen bah oseret al otah sheyyesh bah, lepi shekkevan shehi meshuka mikkenegdah d' tepachim berochab, hare enah yekola lehishtammesh bah ella al yede zeriqat haddeli laavir berochab d' tepachim, veen adam oser al chabero derek avir berochab, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sha"v, lepi shettashmish sheal yede zeriqa baavir d' tepachim berochab eno chashub tashmish kelal:
